title: Derived constant wait threshold on real data with constructed arrival delays

decision_rule.latency: Derived threshold p95 latency below Wait-if-uncertain p95 in all 7 rotations
decision_rule.errors: Derived threshold error count within the paired 95% interval of the Proposed policy in at least 5 of 7 rotations

notes: Delay family matches the synthetic delayed-imagery condition (70% late, median 900 s, forecast error sigma 0.4). sigma_delay is set equal to sigma_forecast because the manuscript did not record the synthetic delay spread separately; confirm against the package configuration and, if different, freeze a new protocol file rather than editing this one.
